描述_EN: while trainers, like this pair by adidas, were worn throughout the 1970s, the last decades of the 20th century saw a massive explosion in trainers' popularity. trainers as an item of fashion footwear were revived through their association with hip-hop. these trainers were featured within an outfit, consisting of a walé adeyemi bikini top, alexander mcqueen denim jeans, an all saints bomber jacket, and a silja mannien string vest in the 'black british style' exhibition at the v&a in 2004. such devotion has resulted in some trainer brands and styles becoming a prized possession and highly collectable.
描述_ZN: 虽然训练鞋，比如这双阿迪达斯的训练鞋，在20世纪70年代一直被穿着，但在20世纪的最后几十年，训练鞋的流行程度有了很大的提升。 训练鞋作为一种时尚鞋类，通过与嘻哈音乐的联系得到了恢复。 在2004年V&A的 "黑色英国风格 "展览中，这些运动鞋被放在一件衣服里，包括Walé Adeyemi比基尼上衣、Alexander Mcqueen牛仔裤、All Saints轰炸机夹克和Silja Mannien线背心。 这样的投入导致了一些训练鞋品牌和款式成为了珍贵的财产和高度的收藏。
